descriere: Displays the smoothed flux setpoint. The value is referred to the rated motor flux.
Displays the pre-control value for the field weakening current.
Displays the output of the field weakening controller. The value is referred to the rated motor flux.
Displays the effective flux setpoint. The value is referred to the rated motor flux.
Displays the actual output of the Isq current controller (torque/force generating current, PI controller). The value contains the proportional and integral components of the PI controller.
Displays the integral component of the Isq current controller (torque/force-generating current, PI controller).
Displays the actual output of the Isd current controller (flux-generating current, PI controller). The value contains the proportional and integral components of the PI controller.
Displays the integral component of the Isd current controller (flux-generating current, PI controller).
Displays the limit value for the integral component of the Isd current controller.
Displays the actual output of the quadrature channel de-coupling for the d axis.
Displays the actual output of the quadrature channel de-coupling for the q axis.
Displays the status of the motor model.
Induction motor (ASM): Displays the referred real system deviation for the adaptation circuit of the motor model. Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PEM): Not used.

descriere_scurta: Motor model speed adaptation Kp effective
descriere: Displays the effective proportional gain of the controller for the speed adaptation.

descriere_scurta: Motor model speed adaptation Vi effective
descriere: Displays the effective gain of the integral component of the controller for speed adaptation.

descriere_scurta: Motor model speed adaptation proportional component
descriere: Displays the P component of the controller for speed adaptation.

descriere_scurta: Motor model speed adaptation I comp.
descriere: Displays the I component of the controller for speed adaptation.
Displays the difference between the motor model flux angle and the transformation angle.

descriere_scurta: Motor model Lh adaptation power-on frequency
descriere: Displays the power-on stator frequency/ primary section frequency for the Lh adaptation for the induction motor (ASM).

descriere_scurta: Motor model Lh adaptation power-on slip
descriere: Displays the power-on slip frequency for the Lh adaptation for the induction motor (ASM).

descriere_scurta: DC link voltage actual value for U_max calculation
descriere: DC link voltage used to determine the maximum possible output voltage.
Displays the effective modulator mode.
Sets the configuration for the modulator.
Sets the threshold voltage drop of the valves (power semiconductor devices) to be compensated.

descriere_scurta: Compensation valve lockout time phase U
descriere: Sets the valve lockout time to compensate for phase U.

descriere_scurta: Compensation valve lockout time phase V
descriere: Sets the valve lockout time to compensate for phase V.

descriere_scurta: Compensation valve lockout time phase W
descriere: Sets the valve lockout time to compensate for phase W.

Sets the current level for the dead time compensation. Above the current level, the dead time - resulting from the converter switching delays - is compensated by a previ- ously calculated constant value. If the relevant phase current setpoint falls below the absolute value defined by p1832, the corrective value for this phase is continuously reduced.

Displays the status of the test pulse evaluation. Short-circuit test: Bit 0: The short-circuit test was executed without any fault. Bit 1: A phase short circuit has been detected. Bit 2: A ground fault test was successfully performed. Bit 3: A ground fault was detected. Bit 4: A test pulse longer than one sampling time has occurred
Sets the number of phases to be identified.
Displays the determined moment of inertia of the drive. After it has been determined, the value is transferred to p0341, p0342.
Displays the angular difference between the actual electrical commutation angle and the angle determined by the pole position identification.

Displays the saturation characteristic of the pole position identification routine (saturation technique). Displays the current characteristic of the pole position identification routine (elasticity technique).

Displays the trigger characteristic of the pole position identification routine. The values for the characteristic of the last pole position identification routine are output every 1 ms in order to record signals (e.g. trace). The values for trigger characteristic and saturation characteristic are always output in synchronism from a time per- spective.

Sets the reference quantity for angle. All angles specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).

Sets the reference quantity for acceleration rates. All acceleration rates specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).
Displays the effective control word 1 (STW1) of the drive for the master control.

descriere_scurta: Sum of fault and alarm buffer changes
descriere: Displays the sum of all of the fault and alarm buffer changes in the drive unit.
This counter is incremented every time the alarm buffer changes.
Displays the code of the last alarm that occurred.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller motorized potentiometer setpoint memory
descriere: Displays the setpoint memory for the motorized potentiometer of the technology controller. For p2230.0 = 1, the last setpoint that was saved is entered after ON.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller motorized potentiometer setpoint after RFG /
descriere: Displays the effective setpoint after the internal ramp-function generator for the motorized potentiometer of the technology controller.
Displays the smoothed setpoint after the setpoint filter (PT1) of the technology controller.
Displays the error (system deviation) between the setpoint and actual value of the technology controller.
Sets the delay time for external fault 3.
Displays the fault value of the oldest active fault.
Displays the component number of the oldest fault that is still active.

descriere_scurta: Phase failure signal motor monitoring time
descriere: Sets the monitoring time for phase failure detection of the motor.
Displays the status word for the drive unit.
Displays the counter reading for modified BICO interconnections on this device. The counter is incremented by one for each modified BICO interconnection.
Displays the number of parameters for this drive unit. The number comprises the device-specific and the drive-specific parameters.

Displays the number of hardware sampling times that can still be assigned. These free sampling times can be used by OA applications such as DCC (Drive Control Chart) or FBLOCKS (free function blocks).
Displays the macro currently being executed on the drive object.
Sets the enable signals for the safe motion monitoring.
Sets the function specification for the safe motion monitoring.
Sets the function configuration for safe motion monitoring.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion behavior during pulse suppression (processor 2)
descriere: Sets the behavior of safety functions and their feedback during pulse suppression in encoderless operation.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion act. val. comparison tolerance (crossw.) (processor 2)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the crosswise data comparison of the actual position between processors 1 and 2.
Sets the velocity limit for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx). When this limit value is undershot, the signal "SSM feedback signal active" is set.
Sets the velocity hysteresis for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SAM actual velocity tolerance (processor 2)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance for the "SAM" function.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS changeover delay time (processor 2)
descriere: Sets the delay time for the SLS changeover for the function "safely limited speed" (SLS). When transitioning from a higher to a lower safely-limited velocity/speed stage, within this delay time, the "old" velocity stage remains active. Even if SLS is activated from the state "SLS in active", then this delay is still applied.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression delay time (processor 2)
descriere: Sets the delay time for the safe pulse suppression after STOP B / SS1. In the case of encoderless motion monitoring functions with safe brake ramp monitoring (p9306 = 1) and the OFF3 ramp enabled at the same time (p9507.3 = 0), the parameter has no effect.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test mode time limit (processor 2)
descriere: Sets the maximum time for the acceptance test mode. If the acceptance test mode takes longer than the selected time limit, then the mode is automatically terminated.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression shutdown speed (processor 2)
descriere: Sets the shutdown speed for the pulse suppression. Below this speed "standstill" is assumed and for STOP B / SS1, the pulses are suppressed (by changing to STOP A).
Sets the tolerance for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). This motion in the monitored direction is still permissible before safety message C30716 is initiated.

Sets the delay time for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). When selecting the SDI function, motion in the monitored direction is permissible as a maximum for this time; this means that this time can be used for braking existing motion.

Sets the stop response for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). This setting applies to both directions of motion. In the case of encoderless motion monitoring (p9306 = 1), only a value of 0 or 1 is permitted.
Sets the velocity tolerance limit for the "SAM" function. SAM is de-activated once the set velocity limit has been undershot.
Setting to select and de-select the acceptance test mode.
Displays the status of the acceptance test mode.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp reference value (processor 2)
descriere: Sets the reference value to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9381 (reference value) and p9383 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp delay time (processor 2)
descriere: Sets the delay time for monitoring the brake ramp. Monitoring of the brake ramp starts once the delay time has elapsed.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp monitoring time (processor 2)
descriere: Sets the monitoring time to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9381 (reference value) and p9383 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless filter time (P2)
descriere: Sets the filter time for smoothing the actual value with sensorless actual value sensing.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing minimum current (P2)
descriere: Sets the minimum current for encoderless actual value sensing in reference to 10 mA (i.e. when 1 % = 10 mA). - The value must be increased if C30711 has occurred with message value 1042. - The value must be decreased if C30711 has occurred with message value 1041. For synchronous motors, the following condition must be fulfilled: |p0305 x p9783| >= p9388 x 1.2

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless accel. limit (P2)
descriere: Sets the acceleration limit to filter velocity fluctuations. If this percentage value is increased, when accelerating, velocity peaks that do not reflect the real velocity charac- teristic can occur.

descriere_scurta: BICO interconnections signal source search first index
descriere: Displays the first index of the signal source being searched for. The signal source to be searched for is set in p9484 (BICO-coded) and the search result is specified using the num- ber (r9485) and the first index (r9486).
Sets the enable signals for the safe motion monitoring.
Sets the function specification for the safe motion monitoring.
Sets the function configuration for safe motion monitoring.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion behavior during pulse suppression (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the behavior of safety functions and their feedback during pulse suppression in encoderless operation.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS setpoint speed limit (processor 1)
descriere: This is an evaluation factor to define the setpoint limit from the selected actual speed limit. The active SLS limit value is evaluated with this factor and is made available as setpoint limit in r9733.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion act. val. comparison tolerance (crossw.) (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the crosswise data comparison of the actual position between processors 1 and 2.
Sets the velocity limit for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx). When this limit value is undershot, the signal "SSM feedback signal active" is set.
Sets the velocity hysteresis for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SAM actual velocity tolerance (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance for the "SAM" function.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS changeover delay time (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the delay time for the SLS changeover for the function "safely limited speed" (SLS). When transitioning from a higher to a lower safely-limited velocity/speed stage, within this delay time, the "old" velocity stage remains active. Even if SLS is activated from the state "SLS in active", then this delay is still applied.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression delay time (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the delay time for the safe pulse suppression after STOP B. In the case of encoderless motion monitoring functions with safe brake ramp monitoring (p9506 = 1) and the OFF3 ramp enabled at the same time (p9507.3 = 0), the parameter has no effect.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test mode time limit (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the maximum time for the acceptance test mode. If the acceptance test mode takes longer than the selected time limit, then the mode is automatically terminated.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion forced checking procedure timer (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the time interval for carrying out the forced checking procedure and testing the safety motion monitoring func- tions integrated in the drives. Within the parameterized time, the safety functions must have been tested at least once (including de-selection of the "STO" function). This monitoring time is reset each time the test is carried out. The signal source to initiate the forced checking procedure is set in p9705.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression shutdown speed (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the shutdown speed for the pulse suppression. Below this speed "standstill" is assumed and for STOP B / SS1, the pulses are suppressed (by changing to STOP A).
Sets the tolerance for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). This motion in the monitored direction is still permissible before safety message C01716 is initiated.

Sets the delay time for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). When selecting the SDI function, motion in the monitored direction is permissible as a maximum for this time; this means that this time can be used for braking existing motion.
Sets the stop response for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). This setting applies to both directions of motion.
Sets the velocity tolerance limit for the "SAM" function. SAM is de-activated once the set velocity limit has been undershot.
Setting to select and de-select the acceptance test mode.
Displays the status of the acceptance test mode.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp reference value (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the reference value to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9581 (reference value) and p9583 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp delay time (processor 1)
descriere: Sets the delay time for monitoring the brake ramp. Monitoring of the brake ramp starts once the delay time has elapsed.
